title: About Root Certificates for Zero Trust Browser in Private Access

blocks.text: Root certificates allow admins to have more control over isolation profile authentication. Admins can manage root certificates for their organization and associate them with specific isolation profiles. To learn more, see Creating Isolation Profiles for Private Access.
On the Root Certificates page (Zero Trust Browser > Browser Isolation Private Apps > Root Certificates), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View the list of root certificates.
Edit any custom root certificates that are not the default.
Delete any custom root certificates that are not the default and are not associated with any isolation profile.
